objective.primary: Raise supported exact tool.endpoint accuracy while tightening safety toward the standing production target.
objective.latency: paired mean must not regress; p95 must not regress

design_principles: Schema graph remains the sole source of routing authority.
Semantic models may attach evidence only to registered graph nodes/edges.
Prefer safe abstention to an executable false route.
No benchmark-authored alias, synonym, or unsupported-operation term may be added merely because it appears in development failures.
Language normalization and semantic representation changes must be generic and reusable across routes.
Per-language and per-route worst-case slices are first-class promotion evidence.

candidate_research_axes.description: Represent tool-domain, operation-action, response-field/concept, qualifier, and negative-capability evidence as distinct score kinds. Never compare or average incompatible raw scores directly.
Preserve missing/failed signal evidence as unknown rather than zero. Each decision surface must declare whether unknown means no-match, escalation, or fail-closed.
Filter the trusted schema graph first by caller/policy/health/tool-domain evidence, then resolve operation only inside that authorized subset.
Model natural unsupported-operation families as explicit negative capability evidence without benchmark-specific keyword lists or model-authored routes.
Calibrate direct-accept, rerank, and abstain thresholds per evidence/boundary kind instead of using one universal semantic threshold.
Improve Korean/Japanese and code-switched operation semantics using generic multilingual representations or canonicalization, validated with family-level holdout.

research_hygiene.current_0_10_graph_dev: may be used only for retrospective diagnosis of the completed 0.10 cycle; do not reuse it as the sole selection corpus for the next cycle
research_hygiene.corpus_generation: Do not generate the next cycle's fresh corpora until the current graph-projection cycle is formally closed.
research_hygiene.benchmark_leakage_policy: Do not include instructions such as unsupported, reject, schema support, endpoint selection, or capability graph as label-revealing wrapper cues in production-claim calibration/blind corpora.

problem_definition_evidence.design_implication: Prioritize multilingual tool-domain separation before within-tool operation discrimination. Test hierarchical or multi-view graph evidence on fresh next-cycle development data rather than adding benchmark-specific aliases.

typed structured uncertainty and boundary-specific thresholds

prior_cycle_evidence.lesson: Natural fresh calibration improved supported routing and latency but exposed insufficient unsupported-capability boundary modeling. Do not tune the frozen candidate; start fresh development.
